data.one_liner: CLI tool to generate Flutter apps, features, API models, and translations.
data.what_it_does: Thunder CLI helps you bootstrap new Flutter applications with GetX, BLoC, or Cubit in seconds. It provides command-line generation for features, API models from JSON or endpoints, complete Postman collection code generation, and automated localizations.
use_when: You want to rapidly scaffold a new Flutter application with predefined architecture.
You need to quickly generate API models from JSON responses or Postman collections.
You want automated feature generation supporting GetX, BLoC, or Cubit state management.
avoid_when: You are maintaining an existing custom architecture that does not conform to Thunder's templates.
You prefer manual setup and dependency injection configuration.
strengths: Supports multiple state management options (GetX, BLoC, Cubit).
Generates models, routes, dependencies, and translations from the command line.
Can parse Postman collections to build entire APIs, repositories, and state handlers.
weaknesses: Enforces a specific folder structure and template architecture.
Translations rely on Google Translate and require manual review.
data.setup_notes: Install globally via Dart pub: `dart pub global activate thunder_cli`, and ensure Flutter is installed.
data.minimal_example:
thunder init shop_app --state bloc
thunder feature product_details
thunder model --name post --url https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts
